text: Mobile banking password reset: open Settings, select Reset Password, and follow identity verification. Never share one-time codes.
Mortgage applications require independent underwriting. Interest signals do not establish eligibility or approval.
Mortgage partner sharing requires approved contracts, explicit applicable consent, data minimization and compliance review. Do not share raw customer profiles.
Fraud alert rules trigger human investigation; an alert alone is not proof of wrongdoing. Maintain audit trails and review outcomes.
Employees request leave through the HR portal. Managers approve leave under the published HR policy.
Annual compliance training completion is monitored by HR using the governed training completion rate.
